params.body:
## What

Tapping a project in Netwerk showed the project's name, then the list of its relations, then the handover panel. The panel had no heading, so it read as belonging to the last relation in the list, and nothing said that a project and each of its relations each have their own handover.

- Every handover panel opens with a heading that names what it is for: "Overdracht van dit project", "van deze relatie", "van deze persoon", "van deze machine", "van dit materiaal". This holds wherever the panel shows (Netwerk, Te doen, Bouwsoft).
- In Netwerk a project's panel now sits right under the project's name. The relations follow in their own block, with "Tik op een relatie voor haar eigen overdracht." and an arrow on each row.
- With a single relation the warning reads "Niemand neemt deze relatie over." instead of "een van deze relaties".

## Checks

- 353 PHP tests and pint pass; NetworkTest checks the headings and the order.
- Checked on a demo copy.
